user.title: Connect to Tellybox
user.description: Create a token on Tellybox's Integrations page (Admin → Integrations). Choose "Read and control" to use the override buttons, or "Read only" for a status display.

data_description.url: The address you open Tellybox on, for example {example_url}
data_description.token: Starts with tbx_. It is shown only once when you create it.

reauth_confirm.title: New Tellybox token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} no longer works; it may have been revoked. Create a new one on Tellybox's Integrations page.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Tellybox at this address.
error.not_tellybox: This address doesn't look like a Tellybox (version with the admin API needed).
error.invalid_url: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This Tellybox is already set up.
abort.wrong_instance: That token belongs to a different Tellybox.

data_description.control: Turn off for a read-only token, such as a status display.
data_description.tv_unreachable_minutes: Home Assistant raises a Repairs warning when Tellybox can't reach the TV for this many minutes. 0 turns it off.
data_description.disk_free_gb: Home Assistant raises a Repairs warning when the media disk has less free space than this. 0 turns it off.

forbidden.message: This Tellybox token is read-only. Create a "Read and control" token to use parent controls.

time_up.message: Tellybox refused: someone in the group is out of time.

unavailable.message: Tellybox can't reach the TV right now; nothing was changed.

control_disabled.message: Parent controls are turned off in the Tellybox options.

auth.message: Tellybox refused the token; Home Assistant will ask for a new one.

invalid_target.message: {device} isn't a Tellybox or a kid's device.

mixed_targets.message: Choose either the Tellybox device (everyone) or kids' devices, not both.

multiple_servers.message: Choose devices of one Tellybox at a time.

no_kids.message: No kids to play for: choose a kid's device, or start something in Tellybox first.

tv_unreachable.title: Tellybox can't reach the TV
tv_unreachable.description: Tellybox has not been able to reach its TV for {minutes} minutes or more, so nothing can be played on it. Check that the Chromecast is powered and on the network. This clears by itself when the TV is reachable again.

no_visible_shows.title: {name} has no shows to watch
no_visible_shows.description: No shows are visible to {name}, so the kid app is empty. In Tellybox's admin pages, give {name} access to at least one show. This clears by itself.

subscriptions_unhealthy.title: Tellybox subscriptions are failing
subscriptions_unhealthy.description: {count} channel subscription(s) have been failing for 7 days or more. Check them in Tellybox's admin pages. This clears by itself once they work again.

disk_low.title: Tellybox is low on disk space
disk_low.description: Only {free_gb} GB is free on Tellybox's media disk, below your limit of {threshold_gb} GB. Free up space or add storage. You can change the limit in the integration's options. This clears by itself.

add_time.name: Add time
add_time.description: Gives extra minutes today. Target the Tellybox device for everyone, or kids' devices.

device_id.name: Tellybox or kids
device_id.description: The Tellybox device (everyone) or kids' devices.

set_unlimited_today.name: Unlimited today
set_unlimited_today.description: Lifts the allowance and the session limit for the rest of today.

device_id.name: Tellybox or kids
device_id.description: The Tellybox device (everyone) or kids' devices.

block_today.name: Block today
block_today.description: Blocks watching for the rest of today, immediately.

device_id.name: Tellybox or kids
device_id.description: The Tellybox device (everyone) or kids' devices.

clear_overrides.name: Clear today's overrides
clear_overrides.description: Clears unlimited and block for today. Extra minutes stay.

device_id.name: Tellybox or kids
device_id.description: The Tellybox device (everyone) or kids' devices.

stop_now.name: Stop now
stop_now.description: Stops what's playing on the TV, without grace.

play_episode.name: Play episode
play_episode.description: Plays an episode for kids. Refused when one of them is out of time.

device_id.name: Tellybox or kids
device_id.description: Kids' devices; the Tellybox device means the kids who watched last.
